title: Abelian Ext counit computed on a fixed abelian resolution
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], F an X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and I and J injective module resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of F and f_*F respectively. Write T_X and T_Y for forgetting to abelian sheaves. Fix R=injectiveResolution(T_X F). Form the forgotten augmentation of J, apply the exact inverse image f⁻¹, and use descOfQuasiIso to lift the coefficient counit f⁻¹(T_Y(f_*F))→T_X F to R. Let c:Γ(Y,J)→Γ(X,R) be the sections of its adjoint TJ→f_*R, followed by restriction along f⁻¹(Y)=X. For p∈ℕ and x∈H(f_*F,p), the homology map of c applied to abelianResolutionIso(Y,J,p)(x) equals sections of r:T_X I→R on homology applied to abelianResolutionIso(X,I,p) of inverse image on Ext with constIso(f).symm followed by this coefficient counit. Here r is the explicit descOfQuasiIso identity lift from the forgotten augmentation of I, and abelianResolutionIso is the comparison of [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization]. This assertion has no module replacement K, map l or comparison a.

source.place: Lemma 01F8 and equation 01F9, functoriality via the adjoint coefficient map; Tag 06XR, injective-resolution computation; Tag 03FD, forgotten module injectives are acyclic.

proof.text: The chosen counit lift satisfies its augmentation square by descOfQuasiIso_commutes. The sections isomorphism has the prescribed top-open components by construction. Apply the cocycle calculation to the source module resolution J and the standard abelian injective target.

The forgotten resolution map satisfies its augmentation square by descOfQuasiIso_commutes. Apply the target-resolution comparison evaluation to I and the standard abelian resolution. Compose the two pointwise equalities, reversing the second.

proof_origin.place: Adjoint cocycle calculation, followed by target acyclic-resolution comparison; augmentation squares proved using descOfQuasiIso_commutes.

lean.statement:
theorem abelian_counit_resolution_calculation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (J : InjectiveResolution ((pushforward f).obj F))
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (p : ℕ) (x : H ((pushforward f).obj F) p) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
      (counitSectionMap f F J)) ((abelianResolutionIso Y J p).hom x) =
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
      (((abelianSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
        (forgottenResolutionMap X I)))
      ((abelianResolutionIso X I p).hom (Sheaf.H.map (coeff f (𝟙 ((pushforward f).obj F))) p
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj ((pushforward f).obj F)) p x)))
